outcome: fetal heart function (Tei index for right and left ventricle, isovolumetric contraction time, isovolumetric relaxation time, ejection time, cardiothoracic area ratio, tricuspid valve regurgitation)
fetal cerebral circulation (middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity (PS MCA), middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (PI MCA))
cohort: A group of 115 fetuses from single, physiologically progressing pregnancies.
finding: Fetal nuchal umbilical cord collision did not significantly affect fetal heart function (Tei index or TR), but the fUCAN group showed significantly higher Middle Cerebral Artery Peak Systolic Velocity (PS MCA).
cross-section timing: during 15th to 40th week of pregnancy, with examinations conducted at a mean gestational age of 29+4 weeks
gest_age: 15th to 40th week of pregnancy (mean 29+4 weeks at examination)
